protocol.training: 20 epochs x80 steps,batch4,AdamW .001,wd1e-4,clip1; equal condition sampling
protocol.loss: Existing pos_weight4 equal-window BCE+.1 speed MAE; overlap arms add .25 window surrogate on logit-log4
protocol.checkpoint: Minimum cal condition-macro event Brier every5 epochs, unchanged across arms
protocol.decision: Full public forecast domain, onset timing before optional force; cal-only mixture alpha0/.25/.5/.75/1 and threshold selection
protocol.known_loss_limit: Sigmoid(logit-log4) is exact weighted-BCE correction only at its unconstrained optimum; auxiliary IoU breaks this interpretation. Treat as a calibrated score, not posterior.
protocol.Lovasz_reference: https://arxiv.org/html/1705.08790; independent implementation of set-extension equations
protocol.assessment: Old public TRAIN proxy dates; load after all model/decision choices sealed. Not final.

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

soft_iou.limitation: Observed-proxy event sampling only. Days with zero events remain in bootstrap. Draws missing a condition are excluded; sparse event sets make this interval weak. No formal Queue score.

limitations: Fixed noisy positive-event sampler and previously inspected TRAIN development dates. New optimizer seed but same fit events. Scores are not reliable posteriors under overlap objectives. No promotion without additional seasons/directions/seeds.
